shortDescription: Manages AFM logging profiles configured in the system

options.name: dos_protection
options.description: Configures DoS related settings of the log profile.

options.name: ip_intelligence
options.description: Configures IP Intelligence related settings of the log profile.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the log profile.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to create log profile on. Parameter also used when specifying names for log publishers, unless log publisher names are in fullpath format.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(state) is C(present), ensures the resource exists. When C(state) is C(absent), ensures the resource is removed. Attempts to remove built-in system profiles are ignored and no change is returned.
